evidence: Start: Mini Incident Report gives the incident start as 16:53 Pacific on 30 Jan 2025. End: same report puts the incident end at 06:13 Pacific on 31 Jan, matching the resolution update. Regions: report lists Mumbai and Singapore regions as the affected locations.
notes: Publication date is the Mini Incident Report entry, 31 Jan 2025 12:13 PST (20:13 UTC). Times converted from PST (UTC-8). Stated duration 13 h 20 min agrees with the start and end pair, so duration_min left empty. Only service is Chronicle Security (WORKSPACE_ACTIVITY ingestion delays); no zones named.

evidence: Start: Incident Report impact section says roughly 60 percent of AppSheet requests failed from 09:30 Pacific on 24 Jan 2025. End: the same window closes at 11:20 Pacific, when licensing load shedding recovered. Regions: Northern Virginia and Netherlands are the named affected regions.
notes: Publication date is the full Incident Report entry, 27 Jan 2025 20:11 PST, which is 28 Jan 2025 04:11 UTC; the Mini Incident Report was posted 24 Jan 2025. Times converted from PST (UTC-8). The Mini report description says us-west4 once, apparently a typo; its Regions/Zones line and the rest of the report say us-east4. us-central1 and us-west1 received failover traffic and are not coded as affected. Stated duration 1 h 50 min matches the pair.

evidence: Start: Mini Incident Report places the start of SOAR permission errors at 12:14 Pacific on 3 Jan 2025. End: it gives 11:08 Pacific on 8 Jan as the end, after the faulty update was rolled back. Regions: Regions/Zones line names fourteen non-US regions plus the europe multi-region.
notes: Publication date is the Mini Incident Report entry, 8 Jan 2025 13:06 PST (21:06 UTC). Times converted from PST (UTC-8). The page header shows the dashboard incident as 09:36 to 11:43 on 8 Jan, but the report states impact began 3 Jan. The resolution update says resolved as of 11:06, two minutes before the report's 11:08 end. The stated duration (5 days 10 h 55 min) does not match the stated start and end (4 days 22 h 54 min); the pair is coded and duration_min left empty. The multi-region location europe is also listed and gets no code. Service: Google SecOps (Chronicle Security) SOAR permissions.

evidence: Start: Incident Report summary says the Pub/Sub outage ran from 06:54 Pacific on 8 Jan 2025. End: the outage window closed at 08:07 Pacific, when the config rollback completed. Regions: impact section names ten regions where Pub/Sub, Logging and Data Transfer failed.
notes: Publication date is the full Incident Report entry, 10 Jan 2025 11:23 PST (19:23 UTC); the Mini report was posted 8 Jan 2025. Times converted from PST (UTC-8). A small subset of ordered subscriptions kept an undelivered backlog until 23:09 Pacific (9 Jan 2025 07:09 UTC); treated as backlog after the main impact ended, not as the event end. Customers publishing from other regions could also be affected through message storage policies; those regions are not named. Services: Cloud Pub/Sub, Cloud Logging (26 min export delay), BigQuery Data Transfer Service (20 min). Stated duration 1 h 13 min matches the pair.

evidence: Start: Mini Incident Report gives the start of elevated 5xx errors as 08:15 Pacific on 19 Dec 2024. End: it gives 10:55 Pacific as the incident end. Regions: report's Regions/Zones line says multi-region asia; the page lists six Asian regions as previously affected locations.
notes: Publication date is the Mini Incident Report entry, 19 Dec 2024 15:28 PST (23:28 UTC). Times converted from PST (UTC-8). The Regions/Zones line names only the multi-region location asia, which gets no code; the six regions are coded from the page's list of previously affected locations. The page header shows 08:25 to 11:05, and the resolution update says resolved as of 10:56; the Mini report pair is coded. Stated duration 2 h 40 min matches. Service: Vertex Gemini API.

evidence: Start: Mini Incident Report says gemini-1.5-flash-002 latency and errors began at 17:15 Pacific on 11 Dec 2024. End: it gives 06:03 Pacific on 13 Dec as the end. Regions: only the US multi-region location is named.
notes: Publication date is the Mini Incident Report entry, 15 Dec 2024 23:21 PST, which is 16 Dec 2024 07:21 UTC. Times converted from PST (UTC-8). No region is named; the only location is the multi-region us (multiregion-us), which gets no code, so scope is unclear and regions empty. Status updates said impact began 18:00 on 11 Dec, and the resolution update says resolved as of 09:00 on 13 Dec; the Mini report pair is coded. Stated duration 1 day 12 h 48 min matches. evidence: Start: Incident Report impact section says export failures to Drive occurred from about 14:21 Pacific on 4 Dec 2024. End: a 17:40 status update says most customers were no longer affected as of 17:30 Pacific. Regions: report calls the impact global, all regions; page lists 39 regions.
notes: Publication date is the full Incident Report entry, 10 Dec 2024 11:21 PST (19:21 UTC); the Mini report was posted 5 Dec 2024. Times converted from PST (UTC-8). Start is the earliest stated impact time (about 14:21, also when a support case alerted engineers); the summary and Mini report give 14:30. End is the time most customers were restored (17:30); the report also gives a final error at about 17:55 (Mini report end), failures until about 18:04, and resolved as of 18:10. Regions/Zones line says Global; the 39 regions are those the page lists as previously affected. Service: BigQuery (its Google Drive integration and exports).

evidence: Start: Mini report impact list says some Memorystore for Redis instance creations failed from 00:35 Pacific on 16 Nov 2024. End: Incident Report says router recovery at 02:13 Pacific ended latency and errors for most services. Regions: Jakarta region only.
notes: Publication date is the full Incident Report entry, 22 Nov 2024 17:29 PST, which is 23 Nov 2024 01:29 UTC; the Mini report was posted 18 Nov 2024. Times converted from PST (UTC-8). Start is the earliest stated impact (Memorystore for Redis, 00:35), which precedes the 00:47 router fault in the Incident Report and the Mini report start of 00:52. End is when most services recovered (02:13); the Mini report end is 03:36 and the resolution update says 03:50. The Mini report writes the region as asia-southeast-2. IAM impact touched control plane operations on global resources. services_n counts distinct products named as impaired across the header, Mini report and updates (Networking, VPC, Load Balancing, Cloud SQL, Spanner, Logging, Firestore, BigQuery, VPN, Interconnect, Memorystore for Redis, Artifact Registry, Dataflow, DLP, Cloud Deploy, Healthcare, Dataplex, GKE fleet management, GKE, IAM, Pub/Sub, Pub/Sub Lite, Monitoring); umbrella headings (Cloud Developer Tools, Operations, Hybrid Connectivity, Cloud Memorystore) not counted separately. The 12 to 18 Nov fiber failures did not affect service availability and are not part of the event.

evidence: Start: Incident Report says the support ticketing system became unavailable at 21:57 Pacific on 14 Nov 2024. End: the vendor fix returned the system to service at 04:09 Pacific on 15 Nov. Regions: location given as Global, with no regions named.
notes: Publication date is the full Incident Report entry, 20 Nov 2024 04:13 PST (12:13 UTC); the Mini report was posted 15 Nov 2024. Times converted from PST (UTC-8). The Mini report gives 21:59 as the start; the Incident Report's 21:57 is the earliest. No regions are named, so regions empty. Services: Google Cloud Support and Google Workspace Support (the shared ticketing system, also serving Billing support); the report says no other Google Cloud services were affected. Stated durations (6 h 12 min, 6 h 10 min) agree with the pairs.

evidence: Start: Mini report impact list shows Cloud Run, BigQuery and GKE problems from 16:20 Pacific on 29 Oct 2024. End: Mini report gives 19:34 Pacific as the incident end, when GCE and Apigee impact stopped. Regions: Melbourne region, with zones A and C seeing extra latency.
notes: Publication date is the final Incident Report entry, 4 Dec 2024 13:43 PST (21:43 UTC); an earlier Incident Report was posted 8 Nov 2024 and the Mini report 30 Oct 2024. Times converted from PDT (UTC-7), as daylight saving time was in effect on 29 Oct 2024. Start is the earliest stated impact (16:20, three services); the summary gives 16:21. Network connectivity was restored at 16:43 and the report says most services recovered shortly after, with no time given, so the stated impact end of 19:34 is coded; the resolution update says resolved as of 18:24. Zones A and C saw up to 15 percent added latency and errors for 16 minutes. services_n counts the 22 products in the page header; the Mini report list has 21, omitting Google Cloud Deploy. The two fiber failures earlier that day did not affect service availability.
